what: You see a transcript with gaps. You listen once and type the missing words.
tests: Listening and writing: hearing exact words and spelling them correctly.

scoring.note: Pearson's page lists these scored traits.

strategy: Read the text before the audio starts to guess what kind of word fits each gap.
Type the first letters quickly while you listen, then complete the words.
Check spelling and word endings (-s, -ed) at the end.
example_prompt: The museum opens at nine and ____ at five on weekdays.

strong.why: Correct word and correct spelling with the -s.

medium.why: Right word, but the ending is wrong for the grammar.

mistakes: Writing a synonym instead of the word you heard.
